hypothesis: If a boss is within 200 units, telling the planner to evade and not open a chest keeps that chest from becoming the goal and loses less health in the amusing minute than the 115 hp the 2:43 run lost chasing it.
test: Champion action templates, E24 dash, exploreDistance 300, tater-pup. Planner directive only: until a chest or food is listed, explore; if health is under 40% and food is listed, eat it; if health is under 40% and no food is listed, evade and do not open a chest; if a boss is within 200 units, evade, and do not open a chest or charge a spot; if a chest is listed and no boss is within 200, open it. While a boss is within 200, evade should win, and a listed chest should not become the goal. Inconclusive if no boss comes within 200. A zero chest-goal count is a success only when a chest was listed in that window and was not taken. If no chest is listed while the boss is within 200, the skip is inconclusive; still record whether evade won.
outcome: Died 3:45 on XEPS03, level 10, 1222 kills, 119 damage, about 30 healed. Minute 2 lost 22 and ended 96/120. Amusing at 2:00 (182 left), 6 damage on the outcome. Colorado Queen at 3:02, no queen line. Chests opened 3, all with no boss within 200 (1:45, 1:46, 2:49). No chest was listed while a boss was within 200. Evade won at 2:00 through 2:23 and at 3:05 through 3:13, then explore won at 2:24, 2:29, 2:30, 2:35, 2:41 and 3:18 with the boss still inside 200. Minute 3 lost 97. No evolution. Seed Potato 8/8, Whisk 3/8, four weapons at 1/8, Fertilizer 2/5.
learnings: The skip was not tested: a zero chest-goal count during the boss only counts when a chest was listed, and none was. Evade did win the moment each boss became the subject of a plan (2:00 keep-away 30%, reason a boss appeared; 3:05 keep-away 45%), and it kept winning for one to three cycles. It then lost to explore while the boss was still inside 200: 2:24 explore 36% vs keep-away 27% with amusing 91 left, and the same shape at 2:29 (boss 137), 2:30 (156), 2:35 (83), 2:41 (116) and 3:18 (queen 160, explore 33% vs 31%). Minute 2's 22 hp against the 2:43 run's 115 is a different seed and came mostly after the line had already faded, so it does not confirm the directive. The death was the queen minute's pests (garden-slug 32, tomato-leech 21, sand-crab 18), and the queen's appearance did not log its own plan until the 5-second tick. A planner.goal line is the next test of the fade. The chest-during-boss case is still open.

hypothesis: Refusing a new weapon while a held weapon is past halfway and a passive is on the pick, and saying so in the directive, makes a chest before 3:30 evolve a weapon. An evolution before the queen cuts minute-3 health lost below the 97 hp XEPS03 lost with Seed Potato maxed and nothing evolved.
test: Champion action text, E24 dash, exploreDistance 300, tater-pup, and the E59 goal directive. One change, in both planner.state and planner.pick: take the card that finishes a held recipe. Fertilizer finishes Seed Potato and Seeker Sprouts. Gravy Heart finishes Tater Tot Pup and Peeler. Big Bowl finishes Whisk Vortex. GPU finishes Chip Shuriken. If a held weapon is at 5/8 or higher and a passive is offered, take that passive, not a new weapon. Do not fill a sixth weapon slot until one recipe is ready. Read whether any chest before 3:30 evolves a weapon, and minute-3 hp lost against 97 if the queen is reached. Inconclusive if no recipe is ever one card from done, or if no choice offers a passive while a held weapon is at 5/8 or higher.
outcome: Died 4:11 on Y1EN48, level 7, 176 kills, 242 damage, about 77 healed. No chest listed, no evolution. Tater Tot Pup 2/8, Frying Pan 1/8, Salt Shaker 1/5, Root Network 3/5. Level 5 at 3:00. Minute 3 lost 72, minute 4 lost 53. Six picks, none with a weapon at 5/8, and none offering Fertilizer, Gravy Heart, Big Bowl or GPU.
learnings: The pick rule never had a case. The plan's own out was inconclusive if no weapon is at 5/8 or no recipe is one card from done, and both were true. Root Network won three of six picks (51%, 89%, 77%). The pup was leveled once, at 1:40, 52% over Starch Plating 45%. Explore until a chest is listed finished 30 explores, opened nothing, and reached level 7, so the 2:23 choice from XEPS03 could not recur. Minute 3's 72 hp is not a comparison with that run's 97: different seed, no evolution, top source ice-imp 72.2. Do not score the recipe rule on this run. Retest the same pick text on a goal policy that has already produced a chest and a weapon past halfway (E70).

hypothesis: A planner.goal sentence that says yes to evade when a boss is within 200 keeps keep-away above explore for the whole time the boss stays inside 200, where the E59 state line faded after one to three cycles. A chest listed in that window still must not become the goal.
test: Champion stack from 14:03 (E44 planner.state, E24 dash, E60 elite line, exploreDistance 300, tater-pup, distrustBossRange 400). Change only planner.goal: yes to evade when a boss is within 200; no to chest, elite, charge spot, gems, and explore in that window. Count plans while a boss is inside 200 where keep-away loses to explore or a chest or spot goal starts. Inconclusive if no boss within 200.
outcome: Died 3:38 seed MRDVER, level 12, 1118 kills, 122 damage, ~0 healed. Amusing 2:00, queen 3:00. First chest listed 2:34; 1 chest opened 2:44 from elite; 0 evolutions. Health 108→32 by 2:00, 1/120 at 3:00.
learnings: Planner.goal boss-within-200 sentences kept keep-away at 69–92% over explore during amusing and queen windows; no E59-style explore wins at 2:24+ with boss still inside 200 on this seed. Chest-not-during-boss clause not exercised: no chest listed while a live boss was within 200. Short life driven by chest-starved explore opening and 0 heal, not goal fade.

hypothesis: Walking onto a Boss Lair charges it even when the goal is explore, and that partial charge wakes a Colorado Queen early. Leaving lairs alone leaves a single queen on the ~3:00 clock.
test: Same stack as the run it is compared with. One directive line: do not enter a Boss Lair, and do not charge one. Read the first queen time, and whether two beetle-queen bodies are ever listed at once. Inconclusive if no Boss Lair is stood on and no queen comes before 2:30. A queen at ~3:00 with no second body supports the lead. Y1EN48 is the comparison: lair charged 1.7 of 3 at 1:43, queen at 1:44, a second queen by 3:02.
learnings: Y1EN48 at 1:43, explore ended inside the Boss Lair at 1.7 of 3. Charge the lair scored 16% on the next plan and was not chosen. Queen at 1:44, 116 down-left, lair had been 57 down-left. At 3:02 two queens were listed, 87 down at 99% and 492 down-left at 100%.

hypothesis: The elite a Beetle Nest wakes on this seed is an ice imp. Walking away deals no chest and leaves a hit of about 20.6 that the one-second forecast prices at no damage. Killing that elite lists a chest and cuts ice-imp damage below 72.
test: When a Beetle Nest has just been charged, fight the elite it lists until it dies (eliteSeconds 20), and do not charge a nest while a boss is within 200. Read the fight-target name on the next plan, whether a chest lists, and the ice-imp total against 72.2. Inconclusive if no nest is charged. A zero ice-imp total counts only if an ice imp was listed and then died. Page-walk ticks stay outside an action-template comparison.
learnings: Y1EN48 fight offers were potato beetles until 2:57. The nest finished at 2:58 and that plan listed Ice Imp at 30 down and 54 down-left. Ice-imp 72.2. Two model steps scored no damage and lost 20.6 each, at 3:03 (120 to 99) and 4:09 (49 to 29). The nest was charged with amusing 148 away, which the directive already forbade.
